name: 2026 Korean CSAT Mathematics Exam Benchmark
description: A benchmark evaluating LLMs' mathematical reasoning abilities using the 2026 Korean CSAT Mathematics exam, ensuring zero data leakage by digitizing all 46 questions immediately after exam release. It assesses performance across text, image, and multimodal inputs in Korean and English.
reputation: Provides a contamination-free evaluation environment and a practical perspective integrating performance, cost, and time; includes a public leaderboard.
notes: Digitization pipeline converts exam materials into LLM-ready data; evaluates multiple input modalities and prompt languages.
